styles.name: Minimal notebook
styles.spec: A very simple Notion-inspired document workspace: warm white canvas, charcoal type, thin grey rules, small monochrome icons, restrained sage and amber status pills. Narrow text navigation, large readable headings, inline database tables, generous whitespace. Minimal dashboard chrome. Complexity 1/5.

styles.name: Clean product dashboard
styles.spec: A polished light SaaS dashboard: pale blue-grey canvas, white cards, restrained navy/teal accent, 220px left sidebar, compact topbar, clear KPI strip and rounded panels. Comfortable information density. Complexity 2/5.

styles.name: Evidence-first split workspace
styles.spec: A professional analyst workbench in light neutral slate: narrow icon rail and contextual machine/evidence navigator, two substantial resizable work panes plus a slim inspector rail. Original evidence and explanation/structured facts are adjacent. Typographic hierarchy, crisp dividers, small teal active highlights, amber unresolved. Medium density. Complexity 3/5.

styles.name: Guided workflow cockpit
styles.spec: An advanced but approachable workflow-led interface: horizontal progress stages, compact left task queue, central action surface, right evidence/review context drawer, bottom activity strip. Light ivory/slate palette with indigo selected actions. Explicit process Uploaded -> Extracted -> Confirmed -> Linked -> Reconciled -> Reviewed. More panels but no decorative charts. Complexity 4/5.

styles.name: Dense operations dashboard
styles.spec: A sophisticated dark navy operations console, high readable contrast, cyan active controls, amber unresolved statuses, compact tables, multiple well-aligned panels, collapsible inspector, structured activity feed and command toolbar. Dense purposeful information architecture, restrained colors, no neon glow, no gratuitous charts. Complexity 5/5.

pages.name: Inspection overview
pages.spec: PAGE 1 OVERVIEW. Main heading Plant A / Inspection overview. Inspection picker Plant A, role Analyst, workflow badge Review complete (not all claims supported). KPI counts Machines 3, Claims 18, Supported 15, Unresolved 3, Open requests 3. Machine sections CNC-001 Operating, CNC-002 Operating, CNC-003 Packaged. Mandatory readable claim matrix, columns Machine, Identity, Purchase, Payment, Presence, Installation, Commissioning; row CNC-001 all Supported; CNC-002 all Supported except Commissioning Unresolved; CNC-003 first four Supported and Installation Unresolved and Commissioning Unresolved. Use short S/U symbols with text legend if needed. Selected claim CNC-002 / Commissioning shows Missing certificate, suggested next action Request certificate, related evidence sighting is context only. Navigation Overview, Evidence, Site inspection, Assessment. Actions Review evidence, Start site inspection, Reconcile, View assessment. Include outstanding requests and small recent activity.

pages.name: Evidence workspace
pages.spec: PAGE 2 EVIDENCE WORKSPACE. Main heading Evidence workspace. Inspection Plant A, selected machine CNC-002. Evidence list containing Equipment register (Confirmed), Invoice INV-002 (Confirmed), Payment PAY-002 (Confirmed), Site photo (Confirmed), New commissioning certificate (Extracted, not confirmed). Upload PDF / image control. Large original PDF preview labelled SYNTHETIC CERTIFICATE / DEMO, serial SYN-002, model DemoMill X3, site Plant A, commissioned true. Adjacent editable extracted fields serial SYN-002, model DemoMill X3, site Plant A, commissioned Yes, source Synthetic upload, capture time. Distinct stages Uploaded / Extracted / Analyst-confirmed; current state Extracted, awaiting review. Quality flag chips Blurry, Unreadable, Incomplete, Duplicate ID, Manual correction. Scope linking controls Machine CNC-002, Claim Commissioning, relation Supports / Contradicts / Context and page locator. Buttons Extract, Save corrections, Confirm evidence, Link to claim. Small history drawer entry Extracted, awaiting analyst review. Commissioning badge remains Unresolved; upload alone is not support. Include document preview/fields as dominant content, not a generic KPI page.

pages.name: Site inspection
pages.spec: PAGE 3 SITE INSPECTION. Main heading Site inspection / CNC-003. Machine selector CNC-001, CNC-002, CNC-003 with CNC-003 selected. Mission checklist Capture identifier, Confirm model/site, Record condition, Assess installation, Request commissioning certificate. Photo upload area showing a realistic small photo of a packaged industrial CNC machine in a clean warehouse, labelled Saved photo; do not invent camera inference. Editable observed serial SYN-003, model DemoMill X3, site Plant A. Condition choices Operating / Packaged / Idle / Unknown, Packaged selected. Presence choices Present / Not observed / Unknown, Present selected; installation Yes / No / Unknown, Unknown selected. Source Analyst observation / Management statement, Analyst selected. Capture time and notes Packaged equipment; installation unverified. Link-to-claim checkboxes Presence and Installation. Buttons Save observation and Upload photo. Clear neutral helper Packaged does not prove absence or non-installation. Small right or lower panel Installation Unresolved, Commissioning Unresolved, Next step Clarify installation and request certificate. No fabricated AI condition analysis.

pages.name: Assessment and follow-ups
pages.spec: PAGE 4 ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOW-UPS. Heading Plant A / Assessment. Toolbar Reconcile, Download assessment, Export JSON. Status Review complete with Unresolved claims 3 clearly separate. Claim conclusions table showing Machine, Claim, Computed, Reviewed: CNC-001 Commissioning Supported / Supported; CNC-002 Commissioning Unresolved / Unresolved; CNC-003 Installation Unresolved / Unresolved; CNC-003 Commissioning Unresolved / Unresolved. Selected CNC-002 commissioning detail: Missing accepted certificate, site operation does not establish commissioning; linked site observation shown with source locator. Analyst review form reviewed-status dropdown, required reason, Save review. Follow-up requests list: CNC-002 Provide certificate Open; CNC-003 Clarify installation Open; CNC-003 Provide certificate Open; Create request / Resolve / Reopen controls. Review progress 18 of 18 reviewed, Complete review action. Audit panel entries actor Demo Analyst, UTC time, reason; Earlier finding / Current finding history access. Scope note Equipment evidence reconciliation; financial statements contextual; no underwriting. Keep assessment conclusions and actionable requests dominant.
